name: cat_drink4
desc: little black witch cat held in a tight hug with both arms reaching to the left, its arms and paws stay in place, while being forced to gulp it trembles: small faint involuntary shivers and quick little twitching jolts run through its body, shoulders, back, tail and legs, tiny jerky spasms of one or two pixels at irregular moments, throat and chest swell and sink slightly in steady gulps, face stays the same, nothing added, subtle motion, looping
